messages:
Samir: Thanks everyone for joining the Q&A after today's all-hands :wave:
Samir: A few folks asked to keep a live thread for follow-ups specifically about pricing/packaging, credits, and rate limits — drop questions here and we'll answer.
alex_dev: Quick one — are trial/free credits per-account or per-organization? Do they roll over?
Priya: Short answer: default trial credits are per-account and expire after 90 days, no rollover.
Priya: For orgs created via SSO, credits attach to the org billing account instead — that was asked in the demo.
Lena: Finance note: we can do case-by-case extensions for POCs. Please file a support ticket with 'POC extension' and tag @Lena.
alex_dev: Nice, what's the process? Ticket + invoice? Any docs?
Lena: Ticket is enough for small extensions. For committed contracts we'll handle via quotes/invoice. We'll add a doc link to the FAQ.
jordan_prod: On rate limits: are limits enforced per-API-key, per-project, or per-organization? And is it per-request or per-token?
Marco: TL;DR: limits are enforced at the key level and at the org billing scope for aggregate quotas.
Marco: We have both request/sec and tokens/sec limits. Default free tier: 30 req/s and 50k tokens/min (approx) — console shows exact numbers per account.
Marco: Dedicated customers can set custom limits and we expose a 'burst' allowance for short spikes.
jordan_prod: Does burst get throttled or queued? How do we surface 429 vs queueing?
Marco: We return 429 when rate limit exceeded. For dedicated capacity we can configure queueing with fair-share; otherwise clients should implement retries with exponential backoff.
alex_dev: Example headers please? (so frontend can detect and backoff)
Marco: Sure, responses include headers like:
Marco: ```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 30
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 12
X-RateLimit-Reset: 167890
``` 
Priya: We'll add a small runbook in docs: how to interpret headers, recommended retry/backoff, and sample SDK config.
Samir: Any questions on packaging tiers / Dedicated vs Hosted credits interaction?
Priya: Packaging note: Hosted API usage consumes hosted credits. Dedicated contracts have committed GPU credits and are billed differently — see SBX in console under 'Dedicated'.
alex_dev: If a team has both hosted and Dedicated, can credits be shared?
Priya: Not automatically. Hosted credits apply to hosted API usage. For customers who want a unified billing view we can offer consolidated invoicing as an add-on.
jordan_prod: Can we request temporary quota increases for demos or launches? Process + SLA?
Lena: Short process: open a support ticket with details (endpoints, expected TPS, duration). For priority we need sales/solutions to approve — mention your account rep.
support-bot: Support ticket #12345 created by alex_dev for 'POC extension' — assigned to billing-team.
Priya: Action items: I'll create a public FAQ doc and a short runbook for devs (headers, retry patterns, burst guidance). Marco will draft rate-limit header examples for SDKs. Lena will publish extension process.
Marco: I'll post a sample retry wrapper for node/python tomorrow.
Samir: Thanks team. Priya/Lena/Marco — can you drop the doc links in this thread when live? :thumbsup: 
Priya: Yep, will post links in this thread once they're up.
Lena: Got it — will ping when extension FAQ is live.
alex_dev: Appreciated :heart: 
Samir: Closing thread once we post the docs; great follow-up. Thanks all!
